title: asteriscus spinosus subsp. asteroideus
intro: Asteriscus spinosus subsp. asteroideus, commonly known as Egyptian aster, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. The Egyptian aster plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, fighting bacteria, and lowering cholesterol levels. The health benefits of Egyptian aster are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are thought to be mediated by its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds have been shown to exhibit potential therapeutic effects, including inhibiting the growth of cancer cells and protecting against oxidative stress.
